subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: Should this PR's transfer-aware timeout contract become the canonical Microsoft Teams upload policy before the overlapping SharePoint-send PR lands?
rationale: Both proof-positive PRs fix distinct delivery paths but define the same shared helper with different upload deadline policies, so landing order determines the permanent shared contract.

options.title: Use transfer-aware policy
options.body: Land this helper contract first and update the sibling PR to reuse the size-derived upload deadline while retaining 30-second control-plane deadlines.

options.title: Use fixed five-minute policy
options.body: Land the sibling helper first and revise this PR to use its fixed five-minute upload deadline.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold both PRs until a Microsoft Teams owner defines a different shared transfer-timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Use transfer-aware policy
recommendation.body: Land this helper contract first and update the sibling PR to reuse the size-derived upload deadline while retaining 30-second control-plane deadlines.

likelyOwner.reason: The current file-consent implementation and affected timeout surface trace most strongly to this person's recent merged history.
